# Rank of a group generated by two subgroups

2 results, 1 proved and 1 stated but not proved, quoted from [Deicyde/atlas-lean](https://github.com/Deicyde/atlas-lean) at commit [035e1808](https://github.com/Deicyde/atlas-lean/tree/035e1808ca0c8983682b74153a02628d616d77ce); [its page on the ATLAS site](https://deicyde.github.io/atlas-lean/roadmap/GroupTheory/generation/rank-of-a-group-generated-by-two-subgroups/index.html).

## Ribes' question on generator counts (Kourovka 12.71)

Write $d(X)$ for the minimal number
of generators of a finite group $X$. This is the proposition that for all finite groups $A$ and
$B$ there are a finite group $G$ and subgroups $H, K \le G$ with $H \cong A$, $K \cong B$ and
$\langle H, K \rangle = G$ such that $d(G) = d(A) + d(B)$.

Formalized by `MathlibExt.GroupTheory.GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.rankAdditiveGeneration`, a definition declared in [WantedExt/GroupTheory/GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.lean, line 39](https://github.com/Deicyde/atlas-lean/blob/035e1808ca0c8983682b74153a02628d616d77ce/WantedExt/GroupTheory/GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.lean#L39). [Its page on the ATLAS site](https://deicyde.github.io/atlas-lean/roadmap/GroupTheory/generation/rank-of-a-group-generated-by-two-subgroups/index.html#rank-additive-generation).

## Generator counts of groups generated by two subgroups are not always additive (Kourovka 12.71)

Write $d(X)$ for the minimal number of generators of a finite group $X$. There are finite groups
$A$ and $B$ such that for every finite group $G$ and all subgroups $H, K \le G$ with $H \cong A$,
$K \cong B$ and $\langle H, K \rangle = G$, we have $d(G) \ne d(A) + d(B)$.

Resolved false: the Kourovka Archive answers 12.71 "No, not always" (A. Lucchini, 2001). Since
$d(G) \le d(A) + d(B)$ always holds for such $G$, every finite group generated by subgroups
isomorphic to $A$ and $B$ needs fewer than $d(A) + d(B)$ generators (Kovács and Sim had shown this
within soluble groups).

## Sources

- E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 21st issue, arXiv:1401.0300v49 (2026), Archive of Solved Problems, Problem 12.71 (L. Ribes); resolution: A. Lucchini, J. Group Theory 4 (2001), no. 1, 53-58, Kourovka Archive, Problem 12.71: No, not always.

Stated but not proved: `MathlibExt.GroupTheory.GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.rankAdditiveGeneration_refuted` is written with `theorem_wanted` in [WantedExt/GroupTheory/GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.lean, line 54](https://github.com/Deicyde/atlas-lean/blob/035e1808ca0c8983682b74153a02628d616d77ce/WantedExt/GroupTheory/GenerationBySubgroupsRankKourovka12Problem71Wanted.lean#L54).
